run_mpo_experiment: run the MPO reinforcement learning experiment on a continuous control environment like HalfCheetah-v2
build_experiment_config: build an MPO experiment config with network factory and agent builder for continuous control tasks
configure_mpo_agent: configure an MPO agent with Gaussian policy loss, learning rate, and experience type settings
run_distributed_experiment: launch a distributed MPO experiment with four actors using LaunchPad and Docker resources
create_control_networks: create policy and critic neural networks with configurable layer sizes for continuous control tasks
